item_short_desc: Rothco's Leather ID & Badge Wallet is meticulously crafted to meet the needs of police and public safety professionals, providing a secure and organized place to store your essential items. This leather trifold wallet features a dedicated section for your badge, cards, and ID window, ensuring easy access and visibility. The removable badge tab includes protective padding to safeguard your badge from damage. With 7 card slots and a cash slot, this wallet offers ample storage for your everyday essentials. Please note, badge is not included.
description: Rothco's Leather ID & Badge Wallet is meticulously crafted to meet the needs of police and public safety professionals, providing a secure and organized place to store your essential items. This leather trifold wallet features a dedicated section for your badge, cards, and ID window, ensuring easy access and visibility. The removable badge tab includes protective padding to safeguard your badge from damage. With 7 card slots and a cash slot, this wallet offers ample storage for your everyday essentials. Designed to accommodate shield-shaped badges, this wallet measures 10.5 inch x 4.5 inch x 0.25 inch when open and 4.5 inch x 3.6 inch x 0.5 inch when closed, making it compact and easy to carry. Please note, badge is not included.
